description: Claps and near misses, as segments separated by a frame with no hands: eight claps, the hands coming in from out of frame (0.0-14.1 s); hands brought together slowly and held palm to palm, twice (14.6-22.1 s); a two-hand pinch zoom, then a fist and finger guns with both hands in view (22.6-40.3 s). Only the eight claps should count. MediaPipe reports clasped hands as a single hand; in two of the claps it loses both hands for about 80 ms of motion blur as they close, then finds a single hand between where they were. Held palm to palm, the palm centers stay about 1.2 hand sizes apart, and MediaPipe flickers between one and two hands. Recorded from a live webcam at 320x240 via HandwaveWidget.hands_data, every frame (~40 fps) for the claps and every other frame after that; labels are as the tracker sees them.
